    errors.append(p)
    return None


for bad in (0, 101, True, "20", 1.5):

        raise AssertionError("batch_size=%r should raise ValueError" % (bad,))

# Worker uses queued batch_size

    calls.append((owner, batch))
    return owner

assert calls == [("ownerA", 42)], calls
